title: How to export your ChatGPT data on Mac: ChatGPT app steps, wait times and fixes
metaTitle: How to Export Your ChatGPT Data on Mac: Steps and Fixes
description: Learn how to export your ChatGPT data on Mac: open Settings, choose Data Controls, request the export, then download the zip before the link expires.
targetKeyword: how to export your chatgpt data on mac
intro: To export your ChatGPT data on Mac, open Settings with ⌘, in the ChatGPT app, go to Data Controls, click Export data, then click Export and confirm. ChatGPT emails a download link when the archive is ready, or texts it for phone-only accounts, and the link expires 24 hours after you receive it.
tldr: Open ChatGPT on your Mac and press ⌘, to open Settings.
Go to Data Controls, click Export data, then Export, and confirm the request.
Wait for the email or text. Processing can take up to 7 days, though one writer got theirs in about a day.
Download the zip within 24 hours of receiving the link, signed in to the same account.

blocks.text: Check whether your account can export

This guide covers personal accounts. Two third-party guides that quote OpenAI say Business, Enterprise and ChatGPT for Healthcare workspaces do not offer self-service export. Edu accounts depend on settings that an administrator controls.

If you signed in with a work email, check the account type before you search through menus. The owner or administrator of the workspace can request a copy for you. That is the route the guides describe for those accounts.

blocks.title: Which account is active?
blocks.text: The export covers the account you are signed in to. Switch to the right account first, then start the export. Many people have a personal login and a work login, and each one has its own history.
Open Settings in the ChatGPT Mac app

Start in the desktop app. Click ChatGPT in the menu bar at the top of the screen, then choose Settings. The shortcut is ⌘, (Command and the comma key), and ChatGPT's own Settings reference gives the same shortcut for macOS.

The Settings window has several sections in a column on the left. Read the labels as you go. The guides do not give a macOS version number, and the app changes over time, so do not rely on a fixed spot.
Find Data Controls and export your data

In Settings, select Data Controls. One third-party guide places the export option here, next to the controls for deleting all chats and your account. The Mac Install Guide describes the same Data Controls option in the application menu's Settings, with export data listed beside delete all chats.
Under Export data, click Export. ChatGPT then asks you to confirm. Read the message before you click confirm, because none of the sources captured the exact dialog wording.

blocks.title: Mac path comes from guides
blocks.text: The Mac menu path comes from third-party guides and one Mac install guide. OpenAI's own help article did not load for our research, so treat the labels as a guide, not a promise.
Why older guides mention Voice on Mac

Some older pages describe Voice in the ChatGPT Mac app. OpenAI retired the Voice experience in the ChatGPT macOS app on January 15, 2026, according to 9to5Mac's quote of the release notes. Voice stays available on web, iOS, Android and Windows.
That change does not affect the export path. If a guide sends you to a Voice control, skip it and return to Settings. Data Controls is the place to look for the export.
Use the web version if the Mac app has no export
If Data Controls is not in the app, use the web version. Go to chatgpt.com in your browser, sign in, open your profile menu, and choose Settings. Then choose Data controls, Export data, and Export.
The web steps reach the same account as the app. Start the export from whichever one you can reach. The request covers the same chats either way.
How long the export takes and what the email says

The export is not instant. ChatGPT builds an archive of your account as it is when the export runs. Processing can take up to seven days, according to the Tactiq and memorylake guides. Forbes's author got theirs in about a day, so the wait varies.

When the archive is ready, ChatGPT sends a notice. For accounts with an email address, that is an email. For accounts with only a phone number, it is a text message. Check spam, promotions and archive folders before you assume the export failed.

blocks.caption: Export stages and timing, as the cited guides describe them.

blocks.text: If nothing arrives after seven days, contact OpenAI Support. The datastudios guide quotes OpenAI on this point. Contacting support is a better step than sending repeated requests.
Download the zip before the link expires
The download link works for 24 hours after you receive it. That window is short, so open the notice as soon as it arrives. Set a reminder if you are away from the Mac when the email lands.

Click the link while you are signed in to the account that requested the export. The memorylake guide quotes OpenAI on this point. If the link will not open on your phone, try the same link on a computer.

blocks.title: An expired link means waiting again
blocks.text: When the link expires, you request a new export and wait again. Download the file on the day the notice arrives, and save it somewhere you can find it.
What is inside the export file

The download is a zip file. Forbes described one heavy Plus user's export of three years of chats. It was just over 1 GB zipped and almost 1.5 GB unzipped. Forbes said that case was probably larger than most exports.

Say you have chatted on a personal account for a few years, and you use it for drafts, research and code. Your export may be far smaller than that case, or it may be close. Check your free disk space before you unzip, so the export does not fail halfway through.

Inside, you find your conversations in an HTML file, plus folders for images and audio. Forbes called the HTML file a massive text archive. The archive has no README, and the image and audio folders use random filenames.

items: The HTML file, named chat, holds your conversation text.
The image and audio folders use random filenames, so names tell you nothing.
There is no README file to explain how the folders fit together.
memorylake says large JSON files may need splitting before you open them.

blocks.text: Open the chat file without a crash
Forbes reported that the chat file crashed Safari and Vivaldi. Try another browser or a plain text editor. No source confirmed a fix, so treat these as options to try, not guaranteed results.
Work on a copy first. Duplicate the unzipped folder, then open the copy. If it opens, you know the original is safe to keep untouched.
Mistakes people make with a ChatGPT export

items: Requesting again on the same day. Wait for the first request to finish, as OpenAI advises.
Assuming the export restores deleted chats. It does not. It copies what is there when it runs.
Missing the 24 hour window. The link expires after you receive it, not after you request it.
Checking only the inbox. Spam and promotions folders hold many of these notices.
Using a work login. Business, Enterprise and Healthcare workspaces do not offer self-service export.
Expecting the file to open like a document. Forbes found the archive large and messy.

blocks.text: Keyboard shortcuts that help on the Mac

Settings is ⌘,. Keyboard shortcuts open with ⌘/, and the command menu opens with ⌘K or ⌘⇧P. ChatGPT's commands reference lists these for macOS, along with ⌘F to find text in a chat and ⌘N for a new chat.

If you open ChatGPT from anywhere on the Mac, the launcher opens with ⌥Space. The Mac Install Guide says you can change that shortcut in the app's settings. See [How to use the Option+Space shortcut in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/use-the-option-space-shortcut-in-chatgpt) for the setup.
What to do with the export after you download it

Store the zip somewhere you back up, such as an external drive or a cloud folder you control. The export is a copy of your account at one moment. Chats made after that moment are not in it, so repeat the export when you need a newer copy.

If you want one old chat back in a new conversation, you do not need the whole archive. Open the chat file, copy only the text you need, and paste it into a fresh chat. For files you want ChatGPT to read, see [How to attach a file in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/attach-a-file-in-chatgpt).
When to contact OpenAI or your administrator

Contact your workspace administrator if you use a Business, Enterprise or Healthcare workspace, or an Edu account. For a personal account with no notice after seven days, OpenAI Support is the next step, according to the datastudios guide.
Have the account email and the date you requested the export ready before you write to support. Those two details help the team find your request quickly.

faq.question: How long does a ChatGPT data export take on Mac?
faq.answer: Third-party guides that quote OpenAI say processing can take up to seven days. A Forbes writer got an export in about a day. Plan for a wait, and check the notice you receive when the archive is ready.

faq.question: Where does the ChatGPT export file go on my Mac?
faq.answer: The download link arrives in an email, or as a text for phone-only accounts. Your browser saves the zip wherever it is set to save downloads. Check your browser's download list, or the Downloads folder in Finder, if you cannot find it.

faq.question: Can I export ChatGPT data from a Business workspace?
faq.answer: The guides say no. Business, Enterprise and ChatGPT for Healthcare workspaces do not offer self-service export. Edu depends on what an administrator has enabled, so ask the workspace owner or administrator.

faq.question: Does the export include chats I already deleted?
faq.answer: No. An export copies your account as it is when the export runs, and it cannot restore chats that are already deleted. Export before you clear your history.

faq.question: Why does the export file crash my browser?
faq.answer: Forbes reported that the HTML file, named chat, crashed Safari and Vivaldi. The archive is large and has no README. Try another browser or a plain text editor. No source confirmed a fix.

faq.question: What do I do if the download link expires?
faq.answer: Request a new export from Settings, or use the Privacy Portal that the memorylake guide describes. The link works for 24 hours after you receive it. Wait for any open request to finish before you submit another.

faq.question: Is an export the same as copying my chats one by one?
faq.answer: Not quite. The export is one archive of your account at one moment, with conversation text and folders for images and audio. Copying chats one by one gives you pieces, not the full archive.

steps.name: Confirm your account can export
steps.text: Check that you use a personal account. The guides say Business, Enterprise and ChatGPT for Healthcare workspaces do not offer self-service export. Edu accounts depend on administrator settings.
steps.tip: If you cannot find the export option, ask the workspace owner or administrator for a copy.

steps.name: Open Settings from the app menu
steps.text: Make sure ChatGPT is the active app. Click ChatGPT in the menu bar, then choose Settings. The same window opens with ⌘, from anywhere inside the app.

steps.name: Select Data Controls
steps.text: In the Settings window, select Data Controls. Third-party guides place the export option here for the Mac app, next to the option to delete all chats.
steps.tip: Labels can change between app updates. Look for the words data and export if the name differs.

steps.name: Choose Export data, then Export
steps.text: Find the Export data row, then click Export. The app asks you to confirm the request, so read the message before you continue.

steps.name: Confirm the request
steps.text: Click confirm in the dialog. None of the sources captured the exact wording, so the text on your screen may differ from the guides.
steps.tip: Do not start a second export while the first one runs. Same-day repeats did not help forum users.

steps.name: Wait for the notice
steps.text: Watch the inbox for the account email. Phone-only accounts get a text instead. Check spam, promotions and archive folders. Processing can take up to 7 days.
steps.tip: A Forbes writer got theirs in about a day, so check often during the first day.

steps.name: Open the link within 24 hours
steps.text: Click the download link in the notice while signed in to the account that requested the export. The link expires 24 hours after you receive it.
steps.tip: If the link will not open on your phone, open it on a computer instead.

steps.name: Unzip the download
steps.text: Double-click the zip in Finder to unzip it. One heavy user's export was just over 1 GB zipped and almost 1.5 GB unzipped, so check free space first.
steps.tip: Store the unzipped folder on a drive with room for both sizes.

steps.name: Open the chat file carefully
steps.text: Open the HTML file named chat in a browser or a plain text editor. Forbes reported that Safari and Vivaldi crashed on it. Keep the image and audio folders beside it.
steps.tip: Work on a copy of the folder so the original stays untouched.

troubleshooting.problem: Data Controls is missing from Settings
troubleshooting.fix: Your account may be a workspace account, which does not offer self-service export. Ask the workspace administrator. For a personal account, try the web path at chatgpt.com: profile menu, Settings, Data controls, Export data.
Check spam, promotions and archive folders. Phone-only accounts get a text instead. If nothing arrives after 7 days, contact OpenAI Support, as the datastudios guide advises.
The link works for 24 hours after you receive it. Request a new export from Settings, or through the Privacy Portal named in the memorylake guide. Wait for any open request to finish first.

troubleshooting.problem: Export requests fail when repeated on the same day
troubleshooting.fix: Wait for the existing request to finish before you submit another. The memorylake guide says same-day repeats did not help forum users.

troubleshooting.problem: The chat file crashes Safari or Vivaldi
troubleshooting.fix: Forbes reported this crash. Try another browser or a plain text editor. No source confirmed a fix, so treat these as options to try.

troubleshooting.problem: Deleted chats are missing from the export
troubleshooting.fix: An export copies your account as it is when the export runs and cannot restore deleted chats. Export before you delete anything you need to keep.
